"Indian Food Tasting" will be held at 7 pm this coming Saturday, April 19th at The Cafe Zine, which is located just off St James Street near the City Centre Market. If you're not familiar with them, they have a great selection of teas, coffees and tea bags to go along with their food tasting. They have a good variety of dishes from around the world - including Italian and South American cuisine, plus some local stuff. There'll be some vegetarian options as well.

I hope to be able to post details soon about what they serve.
